field_images.description: Fixed gold triple upward-chevron lift at a grey-stone blue-arched-window building with recessed tall blue doorway. Tree-lined square with planted shrubs, nearby NPCs.
Wide owner game map shows red player ring atop lift on east/right side of Hibernal Avenue, to the northeast of Rouge Plaza and southeast of Dormez Bien Cemetery, southwest of Wild Zone 15.
Named map: Jaune Sector 7 on right/east of Hibernal Avenue, near Café Kizuna southwest and Café Ultimo northeast, across avenue from Rouge Sector 8.
Close owner map shows player red location ring centered on fixed gold Holovator on Jaune Sector 7 building frontage adjacent to Hibernal Avenue.
Owner-reported arrival: pale cream tiled open roof, visible Jaune District title, neighbouring stepped Mansard roofs with pink Mega Crystals, rooftop greenery and blue mountain skyline.

location.side_of_avenue: EAST / player entering from western/avenue side of building
location.street_entrance: Gold triple upward chevron pad beside a tall blue arched-window or doorway on the Jaune Sector 7 building facade, east of Hibernal Avenue.
nearby: Rouge Sector 8 WEST across Hibernal Avenue
location.directions_from_prior: From the Rouge Sector 6 lift east of Sushi High Roller, follow Hibernal Avenue NORTHEAST. The next fixed golden arrows are on the RIGHT/EAST building frontage, south-west of Café Ultimo, north-east of Café Kizuna. Confirm the red player marker atop the gold symbol.
location.reported_rooftop: Standing on wide pale cream roof tiles near lip of roof gap facing a lower/higher adjacent pitched slate roof with grasses, multiple pink Mega Crystal clusters and a low grey roof structure to left; distant blue mountains and Jaune District title overlay.

uniqueness_comparison.group_15_street: WEST of Hibernal junction, on north side of east–west Rouge Sector 6 street south of cemetery
uniqueness_comparison.group_16_street: EAST of Hibernal Avenue, Jaune Sector 7 at separate north-east building frontage before Café Ultimo
uniqueness_comparison.map_comparison: Group15 ring appears to WEST of Hibernal Avenue street, group16 ring to EAST, and a separate fixed gold arrow is visible at former group15 site on image 7507.
uniqueness_comparison.roof_comparison: Group15 roof image 7503 is a wide beige elevated deck with right side hedges and adjoining slate roof; group16 owner image 7509 has a different open cream tiled platform, gap facing pink-crystal garden roof and low grey service-block structure left. These are individual direct observations, not source 23-device category matches.
uniqueness_comparison.source_research_lead: GUIDE-ONLY-H03 (Hibernal Avenue north of Café Kizuna) is now more specifically matched geographically to this site than previously suspected neighbouring Rouge6 site, but online guide's Hyper Beam route / mission 80 are NOT verified.

preliminary_pin.method: Manual wide-map anchor centroids measured on submitted 1536x865 photo; align to existing maps.html original 1920px image Wild Zone pin positions by least-squares affine fitting of five anchors.
preliminary_pin.accuracy_limitation: Control fit is not an absolute location-accuracy bound: manual anchor precision, game screenshot perspective, zone-centre approximations, photo capture distortions and imprecise entry marker centre are additional systematic errors. Needs actual source city-JPG overlay QA and second independent ground-to-roof registration to be called exact.

publication_guard: Mapping research entry and approximate pin *proposal* only. Do not alter live site, existing map overlay code, source-city-map JPG, Supabase, feedback, progress, ladder/scaffold layers or moving Hyperspace portals. No false exact pins.
